prompts.questionText: Session just opened — Globex open (18:00 ET). What just happened to the rolling cycle?
prompts.correctAnswer: Cycle force-resets — this hour becomes the new H1 regardless of where we were.
answerOptions: Cycle force-resets — this hour becomes the new H1 regardless of where we were.
Cycle continues uninterrupted — session boundaries don't affect rolling structure.
Cycle pauses until the previous H3 completes.

prompts.questionText: H1's first 15 minutes are complete. What line signature is this?
prompts.correctAnswer: Perfect Bull — H1 low formed in minute 0-1. Strongest bull. H3 expected higher high.
answerOptions: Perfect Bull — H1 low formed in minute 0-1. Strongest bull. H3 expected higher high.
Perfect Bear — H1 high formed in minute 0-1. Strongest bear. H3 expected lower low.
05 Bull — H1 low formed in minute 2-5. Solid bullish bias.
05 Bear — H1 high formed in minute 2-5. Solid bearish bias.
False 05 Bull — early bear faked, reversed in min 5-15. True direction is bullish.
False 05 Bear — early bull faked, reversed in min 5-15. True direction is bearish.
None — extreme formed after minute 15. No structural bias this cycle.

prompts.questionText: An apex just fired in H2. What pattern is it?
prompts.correctAnswer: Q2 Break — Q2 continued past Q1, Q3 broke Q2 opposite side. Mid-hour reversal.
answerOptions: Q1 Sweep — Q1 took H1 expected extreme, Q2 reversed to opposite side. Fastest reversal.
Q2 Break — Q2 continued past Q1, Q3 broke Q2 opposite side. Mid-hour reversal.
Q3 Break — Q3 continued past Q2, Q4 broke Q3 opposite side. Latest apex.
